8	Lane axes: **operability + coverage**. Operability is the lowest non-retired axis
9	(score 9, terminal integer under the frozen `f_O` proxy). Coverage aggregate is retired at
10	saturation; the coverage move this round is a frontier-band advance. The stagnation nudge is

14	## C1 — operability (lowest non-retired axis): capability acquisition `dispatch-evidence`
15	
16	**Surface.** The lane's own round-dispatch evidence. Today a report states its dispatch counts
17	from the launcher progress file by hand (the R58-V2 class: "a prepared spec is not a dispatch");
18	no committed gate reads that record. `scripts/wave-census.mjs` reads the *validated payload* and
19	the report files; it never reads `launcher-progress.tsv` or the actual dispatch registry
20	(`grep -n "launcher-progress\|dispatch-actual" scripts/wave-census.mjs` → 0 hits). This round adds
21	`scripts/dispatch-evidence.mjs`, contract `kumitate-dispatch-evidence-v1`:
22	
23	- reads `<root>/.ufo/waves/round-<N>/<wave>/launcher-progress.tsv` (the machine-written record:
24	  seat, pid, session id, exit code) and the sibling `dispatch-actual.json` (the summary a
25	  report quotes) and the seat report files;
26	- findings `PLAN_MISMATCH`, `SESSION_MISMATCH`, `REPORT_ABSENT`, `DEAD_SEAT_UNCREDITED`,
27	  `DEAD_MISMATCH`, `REGISTRY_MISMATCH`, `NOT_A_DISPATCH`, `EXPECT_MISMATCH`;
28	- `NOT_A_DISPATCH` is the class the round's own report must not commit: a registry whose members
29	  carry no session id is a *prepared spec*, never a dispatch;
30	- a dead seat (exit ≠ 0, no session id) is named and never credited;
31	- verdict `DISPATCH_EVIDENCE: CLEAN (seats=… sessions=… exit0=… reports=… dead=…)` exit 0,
32	  `DRIFT` exit 1, `FAIL-CLOSED` exit 2, usage 64;
33	- `--selftest` builds hermetic fixtures in `mkdtemp` and prints
34	  `DISPATCH_EVIDENCE_SELFTEST: PASS (n/n)` + `VERDICT: PASS`.

39	prints `DISPATCH60: DISPATCH60_HELD held=10/10 checks=10 rev=<rev> rule=A60` and exits 0.

104	- **Theme:** ONE — frontier band 4 (durable-execution and multi-agent failure research).
105	- **Adopted:** the two entries above, on seven rows (S126, S131, S133, S134, S135, S190, S194).

107	  arXiv 2609.29095 document the detection entry grounds as `S134`; one document under two ids
108	  in the staged set. Adopting both would add a duplicate-URL group and count one paper twice.
109	  *Flip:* a later band-4 round re-points the S134/S141 pair by document (one id per document),
110	  pins the group, and adopts the measured scope under a single id. (2)
111	  `multi-agent-coordinator-topologies.md` — a different theme (coordinator topology and its
112	  measured cost), not band 4's failure research. *Flip:* a later round whose one theme is
113	  coordinator topology re-opens S130 and S132.

115	  round 59 already adopted from this same package, document-identical. None of the seven ids
116	  this round adopts is in the collision set, so no citation is re-pointed. The 0–3-leading-space

122	  round's report's *Landed changes*, or an errata names it. The file is not edited. Items 1 and

125	## Wave shape
126	
127	One v1 wave of **32 seats** (policy v1, band 32–64), validated before dispatch and dispatched
128	as one batched `kimi --output-format stream-json -p` call; the parent stays alive until every

132	swarm role — and the bounded planning data-walk rides the scout/connector/revenger items. A dead
133	seat is reported and never replaced.
